subject: general
question:
**Direction: Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'.**

Leaders are self-direct,/but learning and understanding/ are the keys to self-direction.
solution:
Here, the erroneous part is **"****Leaders are self-direct,"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the part **"self-direct"** of the sentence.
 
• The phrase **"self-direct"** must be changed to **"self-directed"** is made for grammatical accuracy.
 
• In English, when describing someone as having the ability to guide or manage themselves, the correct term is** "self-directed"** rather than **"self-direct."**
 
• **"Self-directed"** is an adjective that appropriately modifies the noun **"Leaders"** in your sentence.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

Correct sentence*: **Leaders are self-directed**__, but learning and understanding are the keys to self-direction.*
